<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[BAE Systems]] is awarded a  [[Pound sterling|£]]19.6bn contract to build nine next-generation [[Hunter-class frigate|''Hunter''-class frigate]]s for the [[Royal Australian Navy]] with construction expected to begin in [[2020]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-44649959 (BBC)]
*[[Canada]]'s [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Canada)|Minister of Foreign Affairs]] [[Chrystia Freeland]] confirms that tariffs on [[Canadian dollar|C$]]16.6bn worth of U.S. goods will take effect on July 1, as originally planned, in response to [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[First Trump tariffs|tariffs]] on steel and aluminum imports. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/money/markets/canada-officially-strikes-back-against-us-tariffs/ar-AAzliFN (Reuters via MSN)]
*[[Toys "R" Us]] officially completes its liquidation sales, effectively ending up out of business after 70 years. [https://www.businessinsider.com/when-does-toys-r-us-officially-close-2018-6%3famp (''Business Insider'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 United Kingdom wildfires]]
**As the [[Saddleworth Moor]] wildfire continues to burn for a sixth day, the [[Greater Manchester Fire and Rescue Service]] have requested for military assistance in fighting the fire to be extended for at least another three days. [https://www.huffingtonpost.co.uk/entry/saddleworth-moor-fire_uk_5b3635b2e4b007aa2f7f478d (''HuffPost'')]
**A 22-year-old man from [[Bolton]] is arrested on suspicion of arson in relation to a large wildfire that is now burning on [[Winter Hill (North West England)|Winter Hill]] in Lancashire. The fire has now destroyed four square kilometres of moorland close to a radio transmission mast and is continuing to spread. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-lancashire-44654410 (BBC)]
**[[NI Water]] have introduced a [[hosepipe ban]] in [[Northern Ireland]] for the first time since 1995 due to the threat of drought. Elsewhere, firefighters are tackling a large wildfire in [[Glenshane Pass]] for a third day. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-44651240 (BBC)]
*[[List of volcanoes in Indonesia|Volcanoes in Indonesia]]
**Ash from [[Mount Agung]]'s first volcanic eruption since late-2017 results in the closure of [[Bali]]'s [[Ngurah Rai International Airport]] until at least 7 pm local time (11:00 UTC). The ash cloud cancels 48 flights, affecting 8,334 passengers. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-volcano-aiport/ash-from-erupting-volcano-shuts-airport-in-indonesias-bali-idUSKBN1JO3FX (Reuters)]
*Eighteen people were killed and 14 others injured in a head-on collision between a passenger bus and a truck on a highway in central [[China]]. [https://www.iol.co.za/news/world/18-dead-14-injured-in-china-coach-truck-highway-crash-15760750 (''IOL'')]

;International relations
*[[United States–European Union relations]]
**The [[List of ambassadors of the United States to Estonia|U.S. Ambassador to Estonia]], [[James D. Melville Jr.]], announces his resignation from that post because of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s comments about [[NATO]] and the [[European Union]]. He was appointed to the post in December 2015. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-44665862 (BBC)] [https://foreignpolicy.com/2018/06/29/u-s-ambassador-to-estonia-resigns-in-disgust-after-trump-anti-europe-rants-nato-european-union-diplomacy-transatlantic-alliance/ (''Foreign Policy'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Sex trafficking in the United States]], [[Stop Enabling Sex Traffickers Act]]
**The [[Electronic Frontier Foundation]] (EFF), a digital rights organization, files a legal challenge to the Stop Enabling Sex Traffickers Act (SESTA), claiming it trespasses on free speech laws and hinders attempts to help victims and prosecute traffickers. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-44655768 (BBC)]
*[[Cannabis in Luxembourg]]
**[[Luxembourg]] legalizes the use of [[medical cannabis]] for patients suffering from diseases such as cancer. [https://luxtimes.lu/luxembourg/34274-cannabis-for-medical-use-legalised-in-luxembourg (''Luxembourg Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[United Nations]] member states elect [[António Vitorino]] as the director general of the [[International Organization for Migration]], becoming the first non-American to hold this position since the 1960s. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jun/29/un-trump-migration-agency-snub-nomination-rejected-iom (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Unmanned spaceflights to the International Space Station]]
**[[SpaceX]] successfully launches [[Commercial Resupply Services]] payload [[SpaceX CRS-15|CRS-15]] via a [[Falcon 9]] rocket to dock with the [[International Space Station]]. The cargo includes [[Cimon (robot)|CIMON]], a head-shaped [[Artificial intelligence|AI]] robot designed by the [[German Aerospace Center]] to assist crew onboard the ISS. [https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2018/06/final-block-4-falcon-9-crs-15-dragon-launch/ (''NASA Spaceflight'')]
*A NASA study finds exoplanets [[Kepler-186f]] and [[Kepler-62f]] have stable axial tilts to allow for moderate seasons, making it more likely that the planets are habitable. [https://www.cnet.com/news/earth-size-planets-kepler-186f-62f-now-even-better-spots-to-look-for-life/ (CNET)]
